questions.question: Which of the following is a common sign that a chemical reaction has taken place?
options: A change in the shape of a solid when bent
A change in colour, bubbling, or a change of temperature
A liquid turning into a gas by boiling
A solid dissolving in water to make a solution

questions.question: Why do bubbles often appear during a chemical reaction in a liquid?
options: A gas is being produced by the reaction
The liquid is evaporating due to cooling
Air is being trapped from the room
The liquid is undergoing a physical change

questions.question: What happens to the atoms in the reactants during a chemical reaction?
options: They are destroyed and replaced by completely new atoms
They stay in the exact same arrangement but change their size
They rearrange themselves to form new substances
They turn into energy and disappear

questions.question: Which statement is generally true about chemical reactions?
options: They can easily be reversed by freezing the products
They are irreversible, meaning they cannot easily be undone
They can be reversed by filtering out the reactants
They always reverse themselves after a few minutes

questions.question: What three things are required to start a combustion reaction?
options: Fuel, oxygen, and an initial source of energy, usually heat
Carbon dioxide, water, and light
Nitrogen, fuel, and a catalyst
Hydrogen, water, and cold temperature

questions.question: What process does the term 'burning' specifically describe?
options: The reaction of substances with oxygen, commonly referred to when there are visible flames
The melting of a solid into a liquid using a burner
The evaporation of water from an aqueous solution
The breakdown of a substance by electricity

questions.question: Under what condition is water often formed during a chemical reaction?
options: Only when nitrogen and carbon are heated together
If oxygen and hydrogen atoms are present in the reactants
When a metal reacts with a noble gas
If carbon dioxide is mixed with pure helium

questions.question: Which gas is often formed in chemical reactions if oxygen and carbon atoms are present in the reactants?
options: Carbon dioxide
Hydrogen gas
Nitrogen dioxide
Carbon monoxide only

questions.question: What is a characteristic of both carbon dioxide and water molecules formed in reactions?
options: They consist of large, complex structures with weak bonds
They consist of small molecules that form easily with strong bonds
They are highly unstable and break down instantly
They can only exist in the solid state at room temperature

questions.question: What happens during a decomposition reaction?
options: Two elements combine to form a single larger compound
A single compound breaks down into two or more products
An acid reacts with an alkali to form a neutral salt
A solid dissolves in a liquid to form a clear mixture

questions.question: What do decomposition reactions usually require in order to occur?
options: Extremely cold temperatures or freezing conditions
High pressure and the removal of all oxygen
Heat, light, or electricity to provide energy
Continuous stirring in an open container

questions.question: When a metal carbonate is heated and undergoes decomposition, what products typically form?
options: A metal oxide and carbon dioxide gas
Hydrogen gas and a metal chloride
Pure metal and water vapour
Carbon monoxide and a metal hydroxide

questions.question: What is the term for a chemical reaction in which a substance combines with oxygen?
options: Reduction
Decomposition
Neutralisation
Oxidation

questions.question: Which of the following are examples of oxidation reactions?
options: Melting ice and boiling water
Combustion and rusting
Neutralisation and filtration
Dissolving salt and chromatography

questions.question: What is always one of the products of an oxidation reaction?
options: Water
Pure hydrogen
An oxide
Carbon dioxide

questions.question: How do precipitation reactions occur?
options: When a solid dissolves completely into a liquid
When two solutions combine to form an insoluble solid
When a liquid freezes into a solid at low temperatures
When a gas condenses into a liquid on a cold surface

questions.question: What is the appearance of a precipitate clear evidence of?
options: That a chemical reaction has occurred
That the temperature has dropped below freezing
That a physical change of melting has finished
That the solution has evaporated completely

questions.question: How does the total mass of the products in a chemical reaction compare to the total mass of the reactants?
options: The mass of the products is always greater than the reactants
The mass of the products is always less than the reactants
The mass of the products is the same as the mass of the reactants
The mass depends on whether a gas was released or not

questions.question: What is the purpose of a word equation in chemistry?
options: To show the microscopic sizes of individual atoms
To calculate the exact mass of the products formed
To provide a simple way of describing chemical reactions
To count the number of electrons in a molecule

questions.question: What do chemical equations represent about a reaction?
options: How the atoms in the reactants rearrange to form the products
The time it takes for a reaction to go to completion
The physical state changes from solid to liquid
The cost of the chemicals used in the laboratory
